summary: Tested the 'Ricerca da Brevo' tab of Calendario Eventi Italia, backend and frontend. Backend pytest: 11 of 12 pass. Passing: status/KPI, auth required, brevo/lists and import return 400 'Brevo non configurato', cron without auth or with a wrong token returns 401, settings PUT/GET persist and are validated (422), gruppo/tutti return 400 before the test, an invalid scope returns 400, a test job with no BRAVE key goes 'sospeso' with a motivo mentioning BRAVE_API_KEY and the contact goes 'errore', a gmail-only contact without societa becomes 'dati_insufficienti', approving without a date returns 400, approving with a date creates a cal_event with source 'ricerca_brevo' and an organizer and sets the finding to 'approvato', scarta sets 'scartato'. The one failure is a real bug: resuming (Riprendi) a test job that was suspended for the missing Brave key marks it 'completato' without retrying the failed contact, which also unlocks group processing. UI (1920): every requested testid renders. 8 KPIs, the Brave warning, and group/all buttons disabled before the test. The import dialog shows the Brevo error toast without crashing. The test job shows sospesa with Riprendi/Annulla, and Annulla works. Approving without a date shows an error toast; Correggi dati + date + Approva inserts the event; Scarta works; the KPI updates. Regression: the dashboard, fonti and campagne tabs render, and Fonti lists 'Ricerca da contatti Brevo' as Consentita/Attiva with no action buttons. Mobile 390: the buttons row overflows horizontally. All test data was cleaned up and cal_settings.rv was restored (unset). No emails were sent.

critical.issue: run_job increments pos even when the contact failed because BRAVE_API_KEY is missing, then suspends. On Riprendi the failed contact is skipped and stays 'errore'. If it was the last contact, the job goes straight to 'completato'. For a kind='test' job this sets test_completato=true and unlocks gruppo/tutti even though nothing was searched. Repro: seed 1 contact with societa, run scope=test (job goes sospeso, pos 1/1), Riprendi: status becomes completato. Fix: when err contains BRAVE_API_KEY, do not $inc pos (and/or reset the contact to da_analizzare) before suspending. test_completato should also require the test job to have at least one non-error result.

minor.issue: 'analizzati' counts 'errore' contacts as analysed. 'eventi_trovati' includes 'scartato' findings.

When data_inizio is supplied but data_fine is not, data_fine stays null on both the finding and the event (to_calendar's fallback runs only in save_finding). Consider defaulting data_fine to data_inizio.
The same failure repeats for other errors: generic errors (e.g. LLM failure) just skip the contact, and there is no retry path except scope=selezione.

ui_bugs.issue: The wrapper around the group-size select, the gruppo button and 'Tutti i restanti' is 'flex items-center gap-1' without flex-wrap, so the row overflows. body.scrollWidth is 465 on a 390 viewport and 'Tutti i restanti' is cut off.

A contact in 'errore' with fonti [] (Brave failed before any query was recorded) has no 'Fonti consultate' toggle, so the user cannot see c.errore or c.nota in the table. The same applies to dati_insufficienti contacts with a nota.

The 'Brevo non configurato' toast appears twice, caused by the double effect in dev StrictMode. Minor; consider a dedicated 'Brevo non configurato' message inside the dialog instead of 'Nessuna lista disponibile'.

issues: Uses the native <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker

action_items: Fix run_job/riprendi: do not advance pos (or reset the contact to da_analizzare) when suspending for the missing BRAVE_API_KEY, so Riprendi retries that contact and a test job cannot become 'completato' (and unlock gruppo/tutti) without real searches
Add flex-wrap to the group-size/gruppo/tutti wrapper in ReversePanel.jsx (mobile overflow)
Show contact errore/nota even when fonti is empty
Optional: default data_fine to data_inizio on manual approval; exclude errore from 'analizzati' and scartato from 'eventi_trovati' KPIs; replace the native date inputs with the shadcn date picker
critical_code_review_comments: cal_reverse.py run_job: pos is incremented before the BRAVE_API_KEY suspension check, so the failing contact is lost on resume (see critical issue)
MODEL = ('anthropic','claude-opus-5-5'): not verified here because no LLM call is possible without Brave. Main agent says it was verified offline
The FS state map is duplicated in ReversePanel.jsx and FindingsReview.jsx (ReversePanel exports FS but FindingsReview redefines it)
search_contact runs find_one with no None check; a deleted contact gives an AttributeError, which is caught and recorded as 'errore' via update_one on a missing doc (harmless no-op)

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12; the failure is a real bug)

seed_data_creation: Contacts and findings were inserted directly into cal_rv_contacts/cal_rv_findings with TEST_ names. All were removed, along with created jobs, the TEST_ event and organizer, their cal_history, and cal_duplicates. cal_settings.rv was unset (it was absent before).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BREVO_API_KEY and BRAVE_API_KEY are empty in preview. The cal_rv_* collections were empty before testing. Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_cal_reverse_brevo.py -p no:randomly -n0. test_test_job_suspends_without_brave currently fails at the annullato assertion because of the riprendi bug. UI seed: python tests/cal_reverse_ui_seed.py seed|cleanup (ids in /tmp/cal_reverse_ui_ids.json). Log in via page.request.post /api/auth/login and dismiss the cookie banner with the 'Accept all' button before clicking lower elements. Container date is 2026-11-07.
rca of the issue: run_job: after search_contact raises 'Chiave Brave Search mancante (BRAVE_API_KEY)', the code runs $inc pos:1 and then sets status sospeso. On riprendi the loop restarts at pos+1. With a single-contact or last-contact queue, pos >= len(queue), so status becomes 'completato'. active test_done checks only kind=test & status=completato, so gruppo/tutti unlock.
